references.text: Jesus' subsequent clarification that "sleep" means "death" confirms that the misunderstanding in verse 13 concerned the literal meaning of the word.
Paul uses the same Greek word (κοιμάω) to describe those who have passed away in death, establishing a clear biblical parallel to its use in the Gospel of John.
Here too the word "sleep" (κοιμάω) is used for Christians who are dead, and the text draws a direct line between this sleep metaphor and the resurrection, just as in John 11.
